title: T1573.001 — Encrypted Channel - Symmetric Cryptography
subtitle: Watch one full life of a shared-key channel: the attacker builds the implant with an embedded AES key, the implant beacons without any TLS greeting, the SOC spots the shape,...

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Build the implant
steps.caption: The attacker compiles a small implant and hides a 256-bit AES key, called K, inside its config. Some builders instead derive the key from host facts such as the machine GUID, so the key is never written down anywhere
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Encrypted beacon out
steps.caption: The implant encrypts a short beacon with AES in CTR mode, using a counter as the nonce, and sends it. The server decrypts it with the same key K and learns the victim id and uptime
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
